      public NettyConnectorProvider.Config connectionController(NettyConnectionController controller)

    • expect100ContinueTimeout

      public NettyConnectorProvider.Config expect100ContinueTimeout(int millis)
      This setting determines waiting time in milliseconds for 100-Continue response when 100-Continue is sent by the client. The property NettyClientProperties.EXPECT_100_CONTINUE_TIMEOUT has precedence over this setting.
      Parameters:
      millis - the timeout for 100-Continue response.
      Returns:
      updated configuration.

    • enableSslHostnameVerification

      public NettyConnectorProvider.Config enableSslHostnameVerification(boolean enable)
      Enable or disable the endpoint identification algorithm to HTTPS. The property NettyClientProperties.ENABLE_SSL_HOSTNAME_VERIFICATION takes precedence over this setting.
      Parameters:
      enable - enable or disable the hostname verification.
      Returns:
      updated configuration.

    • enableLoggingHandler

      public NettyConnectorProvider.Config enableLoggingHandler(boolean enable)
      Enable or disable the Netty logging by LoggingHandler(Level.DEBUG). Disabled by default. The property NettyClientProperties.LOGGING_ENABLED takes precedence over this setting.
      Parameters:
      enable - to enable or disable.
      Returns:
      updated configuration.

    • filterHeadersForProxy

      public NettyConnectorProvider.Config filterHeadersForProxy(boolean filter)
      Filter the HTTP headers for requests (CONNECT) towards the proxy except for PROXY-prefixed and HOST headers when true. The property NettyClientProperties.FILTER_HEADERS_FOR_PROXY has precedence over this setting.
      Parameters:
      filter - to filter or not. The default is true.
      Returns:
      updated configuration.

    • idleConnectionPruneTimeout

      public NettyConnectorProvider.Config idleConnectionPruneTimeout(int seconds)
      This property determines the number of seconds the idle connections are kept in the pool before pruned. The default is 60. Specify 0 to disable. The property NettyClientProperties.IDLE_CONNECTION_PRUNE_TIMEOUT has precedence over this setting.
      Parameters:
      seconds - the timeout in seconds.
      Returns:
      updated configuration.

    • initialHttpHeaderLineLength

      public NettyConnectorProvider.Config initialHttpHeaderLineLength(int length)
      Set the maximum length of the first line of the HTTP header. The property NettyClientProperties.MAX_INITIAL_LINE_LENGTH has precedence over this setting.
      Parameters:
      length - the length of the first line of the HTTP header.
      Returns:
      updated configuration.

    • maxChunkSize

      public NettyConnectorProvider.Config maxChunkSize(int size)
      Set the maximum chunk size for the Netty connector. The property NettyClientProperties.MAX_CHUNK_SIZE has precedence over this setting.
      Parameters:
      size - the new size of chunks.
      Returns:
      updated configuration.

    • maxConnectionsPerDestination

      public NettyConnectorProvider.Config maxConnectionsPerDestination(int maxCount)
      This setting determines the maximum number of idle connections that will be simultaneously kept alive, per destination. The default is 5. The property NettyClientProperties.MAX_CONNECTIONS takes precedence over this setting.
      Parameters:
      maxCount - maximum number of idle connections per destination.
      Returns:
      updated configuration.

    • maxHeaderSize

      public NettyConnectorProvider.Config maxHeaderSize(int size)
      Set the maximum header size in bytes for the HTTP headers processed by Netty. The property NettyClientProperties.MAX_HEADER_SIZE has precedence over this setting.
      Parameters:
      size - the new maximum header size.
      Returns:
      updated configuration.

    • maxRedirects

      public NettyConnectorProvider.Config maxRedirects(int max)
      Set the maximum number of redirects to prevent infinite redirect loop. The default is 5. The property NettyClientProperties.MAX_REDIRECTS has precedence over this setting.
      Parameters:
      max - the maximum number of redirects.
      Returns:
      updated configuration.

    • maxTotalConnections

      public NettyConnectorProvider.Config maxTotalConnections(int max)
      Set the maximum number of idle connections that will be simultaneously kept alive. The property NettyClientProperties.MAX_CONNECTIONS_TOTAL has precedence over this setting.
      Parameters:
      max - the maximum number of idle connections.
      Returns:
      updated configuration.

    • preserveMethodOnRedirect

      public NettyConnectorProvider.Config preserveMethodOnRedirect(boolean preserve)
      Set the preservation of methods during HTTP redirect. By default, the HTTP POST request are not transformed into HTTP GET for status 301 & 302. The property NettyClientProperties.PRESERVE_METHOD_ON_REDIRECT has precedence over this setting.
      Parameters:
      preserve - to preserve or not to preserve.
      Returns:
      updated configuration.

      Set the Netty Connector HTTP redirect controller. The property NettyClientProperties.HTTP_REDIRECT_CONTROLLER has precedence over this setting.
      Parameters:
      controller - the HTTP redirect controller.
      Returns:
      updated configuration.
